#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by w4_capture.py; runs inside WSL (distro Ubuntu) as the default user.
set -euo pipefail
trap 'rc=$?; echo "wsl_script_exit=$rc"' EXIT
src=/root/gw4-20260924-1247/proofs/linux/execution/domains/wsl-domain-matrix-20260924-1247
dst=/mnt/c/gw4-20260924-1247/proofs/linux/execution/domains/wsl-domain-matrix-20260924-1247
test ! -e "$dst" || { echo "destination already exists"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dst")" && cp -r "$src" "$dst" || exit 1
( cd "$src" && find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum ) > /tmp/w4-src.sha
( cd "$dst" && find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum ) > /tmp/w4-dst.sha
echo "files_src=$(wc -l < /tmp/w4-src.sha) files_dst=$(wc -l < /tmp/w4-dst.sha)"
diff /tmp/w4-src.sha /tmp/w4-dst.sha && echo "copy_identical=True" || { echo "copy_identical=False"; exit 1; }
rm -f /tmp/w4-src.sha /tmp/w4-dst.sha
steps.title: Copy the WSL bundle into the Windows clone and prove the copy byte-identical

argv:
import hashlib, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
ok = True
for d in sys.argv[1:]:
    b = Path(d); m = b / 'MANIFEST.sha256'
    raw = m.read_bytes()
    lines = [l.strip() for l in m.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if l.strip()]
    bad = 0; listed = set()
    for l in lines:
        g = re.fullmatch(r'([0-9a-f]{64})  ([^\r\n]+)', l)
        if not g or hashlib.sha256((b / g.group(2)).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != g.group(1): bad += 1
        else: listed.add(g.group(2))
    on_disk = {p.relative_to(b).as_posix() for p in b.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'MANIFEST.sha256'}
    s = json.loads((b / 'garnet-studio-domain-matrix.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    print(f'{d}: manifest_lines={len(lines)} bad={bad} unlisted={sorted(on_disk - listed)} '
          f'manifest_crlf={raw.count(bytes([13, 10]))} status={s["status"]} platform={s["platform"]} '
          f'arch={s["arch"]} cases={s["passed_cases"]}/{s["case_count"]} '
          f'commands={s["passed_commands"]}/{s["command_count"]}')
    ok &= bad == 0 and not (on_disk - listed) and s['status'] == 'passed'
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import re, sys
def parse(p):
    t = open(p, 'rb').read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    bad = set(re.findall(r'^(?:FAIL|ERROR): (\S+) ', t, re.M))
    ran = re.findall(r'^Ran (\d+) tests', t, re.M)
    return bad, ran
b, rb = parse(r'C:\gw1-stage\w4\20260924-1247-NUCBOX_M2PRO_S\streams\B04-test-file-before.stderr')
a, ra = parse(r'C:\gw1-stage\w4\20260924-1247-NUCBOX_M2PRO_S\streams\V05-test-file-after.stderr')
target = 'test_status_distinguishes_plan_completion_from_goal_completion'
print('before: ran=' + ','.join(rb) + ' failing=' + ', '.join(sorted(b)))
print('after:  ran=' + ','.join(ra) + ' failing=' + ', '.join(sorted(a)))
print(f'target failing before: {target in b}; target failing after: {target in a}')
print(f'other failures unchanged: {(b - {target}) == a}')
sys.exit(0 if target in b and target not in a and (b - {target}) == a and rb == ra else 1)
